Using Thensday

Thensday helps you save things you find and come back to them at a moment you choose. You can use the free features with no limit on saves. You're responsible for what you save and share, and for using it in line with the rules of the apps and websites it came from.

Thensday stores a link, text, a small preview and screenshots you choose. It doesn't download or re-host other people's videos, and it always links back to the original. Content you save belongs to whoever made it.

Thensday Pro

Thensday Pro is an optional auto-renewing subscription that unlocks extra features: the Cook grocery plan, the Sunday clear-out, custom dates, importing more than 5 screenshots at once, and CSV export.

  • Plans. Monthly ($6.99) or yearly ($39.99), or the equivalent in your local currency as shown in the App Store before you buy.
  • Free trial. The yearly plan starts with a 7-day free trial for new subscribers. If you don't cancel at least 24 hours before the trial ends, it converts to a paid yearly subscription. Each Apple Account can use the trial once.
  • Payment. Payment is charged to your Apple Account when you confirm the purchase, or when the free trial ends.
  • Auto-renewal. Your subscription renews automatically for the same period and price unless you turn off auto-renew at least 24 hours before the end of the current period. Your account is charged for renewal within 24 hours before the end of the current period.
  • Cancelling. Manage or cancel any time in the Settings app: tap your name, then Subscriptions. Cancelling stops the next renewal; you keep Pro until the end of the period you've paid for.
  • Refunds. Purchases are handled by Apple. Refund requests go through Apple at reportaproblem.apple.com.
  • Price changes. If the price changes, Apple will tell you in advance and, where required, ask for your agreement.
  • Restore. If you reinstall or get a new iPhone, use Restore Purchases in the app.

Notifications and actions

Thensday sends gentle reminders at the moments you choose and offers shortcuts into apps like Calendar, Reminders, Maps and Contacts. Reminders may arrive late or not at all if notifications are off or your device is in Focus mode. Please don't rely on Thensday for anything critical, such as medical, legal or safety deadlines.
